Respectful Treatment of Unborn Remains Act of 2025
To prohibit fetal remains in publicly owned water systems, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

bill.summary:
Respectful Treatment of Unborn Remains Act of 2025
This bill prohibits abortion providers from placing fetal remains into a publicly owned water system. Violations are subject to a fine, a prison term of up to five years, or both.
The bill specifies that individuals on whom an abortion is performed are not liable for violations.
